description: Évolution des stocks de Gaz Naturel Liquéfié au terminal méthanier de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Elengy, Dunkerque LNG, Fosmax LNG. Ce jeu de données présente la quantité de Gaz Naturel Liquéfié (GNL) stockée en fin de journée gazière (à 6h du matin) dans les terminaux méthaniers français (en m3 GNL et en GWh à 0°) dans le terminal méthanier de la société Dunkerque LNG. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are GNL. The portal shows 120 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2018-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
